title: EvidenceNode
description: One immutable evidence graph node (design §7.1). The payload hash is lowercase hex sha-256 over the canonical payload; money in a payload is BigInt cents (JSON integer or decimal string), never a float.

anyOf.description: BigInt cents as a decimal string

payload.description: Payload content — monetary amounts are BigInt cents (JSON integers or decimal strings), never floats (REQ-CONTRACTS-008)

payloadHash.description: lowercase hex sha-256 over the canonical payload
